lead.headline: Bananini Hits 178.8, Season High
lead.deck: A waiver-wire pickup scored 35.1 from the flex, and the Bruisers lost by 61.42.
paragraphs: {T1} got 35.1 from Emmett Johnson, added this week, 28.2 from Parker Washington, 27.7 from Isaiah Likely and 21.0 from the Vikings D/ST.
{S1} is now 7–3, one of four teams at 7–3. Next up: {S8}, the only team that scored more this week.

sidebar.title: Lost With 117, Won With 97
sidebar.text: {S4} scored 117.38, beat eight teams in all-play, and lost. {S9} scored 97.06, beat three, and won.

6-11.headline: Streak Snapped at Five
6-11.text: Chase Brown 28.3, Blake Corum 20.9. Chuba Hubbard's 34.2 wasn't enough for Kazakhstan.

9-7.text: Jayden Daniels 20.76, Rams D/ST 16.0. Magnificent's best lineup, 104.06, would have won.

3-10.text: Ja'Marr Chase 34.1, Cam Skattebo 27.2, Cam Little 19.0. Pony 0–11 in all-play.

2-12.text: Garrett Wilson 15.6, Lions D/ST 13.0. Amon-Ra St. Brown 25.8 for Bedazzled.

8-5.headline: League Season High: 187.14
8-5.text: Josh Allen 22.34, Tony Pollard 23.9 from the flex. James Cook III 21.7 led CeeDeez.

honor.title: Big Boy Bruisers
honor.text: Smallest bench gap of the week. Dak Prescott 34.42 on a 17.7 projection, Nico Collins 24.4, Malik Washington 13.36. Still lost.

blotter.title: Benched three better players
blotter.text: Rashee Rice 13.2, Dalton Schultz 8.1, Khalil Shakir 7.5 sat. Won anyway.

blotter.text: Josh Downs sat. DeMario Douglas started: 1.4. Lost by 8.7.

6-11.headline: Kazakhstan Falls to a 2–7 Team
6-11.text: {S6} snapped five straight losses and partied like it was a title. {S11} started a −7.0 Steelers D/ST, benched Quinshon Judkins' 16.1 and lost by 5.32. Back to 5–5.

3-10.headline: 8D Wins With Four Zeros
3-10.text: {S3} started four projected zeros and won anyway. {S10} benched Jared Goff's 20.42 for Drake Maye's 3.02, scored the week's low 70.42 and fell to 4–6.

2-12.headline: Doughboys Topple No. 1, Again
2-12.text: {S2} beat the league's top team for a second straight week. McCaffrey 46.3, the week's best player. {S12} picked Burrow over Mahomes' 35.42 and fell from 7–2.

8-5.headline: Beefy Boys Drop 187 on CeeDeez
8-5.text: Season high for the whole league: 187.14, 11–0 all-play. Gibbs 44.2, Pickens 43.5. {S5} went from last week's 156.5, the week's best, to 98.88.
